title: AS2 compiler: ord(s) and chr(n) built-ins not special-cased — should emit ActionOrd/ActionChr
description: In AVM1, chr(n) emits ActionChr (0x33) and ord(s) emits ActionOrd (0x32). String.fromCharCode() is already special-cased to emit ActionMBChr (0x63). The legacy Flash functions chr() and ord() are not special-cased: chr() falls through to ActionCallFunction, ord() falls through to ActionCallFunction. Fix: in compiler.ts, add two more special cases: Identifier('chr') with 1 arg → compile arg, emit 0x33; Identifier('ord') with 1 arg → compile arg, emit 0x32.
